description: Geluidhinder windturbines in 2024 is a dataset listed in Dutch national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by NationaalGeoregister.nl. Op de kaart ziet u welk percentage van de bevolking ernstig gehinderd is door geluid van windturbines. Coverage: the Netherlands. The portal files it under the publisher NationaalGeoregister.nl. Its tags are geluid, ggd, hinder, windturbines. It offers 5 resource(s) in HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/PNG, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/WFS_SRVC, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/WMS_SRVC. The portal shows 2026-08-14 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-nl-portal.
